pictures.name: JBZ1-The-Crowd
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Roman-era Jerusalem on a bright morning. Ben Zoma, a scholar in his thirties with a short dark beard and bright, wondering eyes, in a cream linen robe and a deep blue mantle, stands on a high, worn stone step in the middle of the frame, seen from slightly behind his shoulder, looking down at a huge, bustling crowd on broad stone steps and a market square below: merchants, farmers with baskets, women with jars, porters with sacks. Golden morning light, deep blue shadows in the stone arches. No temple building, only steps, old walls and the crowd.
